headline: Clearer, safer everyday tracking

changes.title: Privacy & Data
changes.detail: New Settings page clarifies browser-local storage, file imports, hosted resources and permission choices.

changes.title: Protected backup restore
changes.detail: Import now previews record counts and requires an explicit typed confirmation, with a local recovery copy and rollback safeguards.

changes.title: More reliable calculator validation
changes.detail: Invalid amounts, syringe overflow and compound-dependent IU conversions no longer generate draw results.

changes.title: More accessible navigation
changes.detail: Larger Settings back target, visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion support and calculator field labels.

changes.title: Notification choices explained
changes.detail: Dose Alerts explains permissions and that background notifications are not provided by this web build.

dataImpact: No automatic migration or modification of existing saved records. A user-initiated restore now requires confirmation and keeps a local recovery copy before replacement.
limitations: Calculator mass conversions support mg and mcg; generic IU conversion is intentionally unsupported.
Physical iPhone/VoiceOver acceptance remains unverified; Cloudflare 16-file parity was verified against the merged application source.
App Store and Play Store native-wrapper submission readiness still requires independent verification.
